user_intent: Implement only the Docs slide of the ClickUp 4.0 carousel as a pixel-accurate 871x530 rebuild of Figma frame 68:31422 with a two-collaborator typing animation, honoring the { active, paused, reducedMotion } contract.
resolution: Rebuilt the full frame in ClickUpFourDocsDemo.tsx/.css from a pre-extracted refs dump (docs-code.txt) and a kebab-case asset manifest, sampling exact backdrop colors from the reference PNG with sharp. Verified with a temporary Playwright shot script against a dev server started with SITE_PASSWORD/AUTH_SECRET env vars, iterating three visual-correction passes; a notable fix was a CSS mask quirk where multiple mask-images union by default, so only the spoke mask was applied to get the intended pinwheel intersection. Temp script and screenshots were deleted after verification.
